result.title: Robust Representation Learning for Spiking Neural Networks based on Conditional Information Bottleneck
result.summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have shown great potential for low-power neuromorphic computing due to their event-driven processing and spatiotemporal sparsity, but they remain vulnerable to input perturbations, hardware-intrinsic noise, and adversarial attacks in real-world deployment. We attribute this vulnerability partly to input-specific hidden representations learned by standard SNNs trained with conventional cross-entropy loss, as our information-plane analysis empirically shows that substantial input-related information can still be retained after label-predictive information becomes stable. To address this issue, we propose SCIB, a simple yet effective robust learning objective for SNNs based on the Conditional Information Bottleneck. Different from conventional variational IB methods, SCIB replaces the mutual information compression term $I(X;S)$ with the conditional mutual information $I(X;S|Y)$ and derives a tractable variational upper bound. Moreover, it introduces a learnable class-conditional prior instead of a label-agnostic isotropic Gaussian prior, improving the expressiveness of variational compression and encouraging class-structured representations when combined with the supervised classification objective. Systematic experiments on Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 under external environmental noise, neuromorphic hardware noise, and adversarial attacks show that SCIB improves robustness over standard SNNs and IB-based baselines under most evaluated noise conditions, improves adversarial accuracy under the evaluated attacks without using adversarial training, and reduces the SynOps-based single-sample inference energy consumption by 24.9% relative to an unconstrained SNN baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）对噪声与对抗扰动的脆弱性，提出 SCIB：以条件互信息 I(X;S|Y) 取代常规变分 IB 中的 I(X;S)，并引入可学习的类条件先验，在 Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR 等任务上提升鲁棒性并降低推理能耗。
AI.relevance_reason: 其信息平面分析与条件 IB 目标可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态如何在保留任务必要信息的同时压缩输入特有余项；但研究对象是 SNN 分类鲁棒性，与视觉推理无直接联系，迁移价值需阅读后判断。
